integrity: Finite cases use a complete enumerator, explicit 32-leaf adaptive witnesses, all 462 five-query VC exclusions, and an alternate minimal-transversal generator. The infinite family follows from mathematical product additivity rather than extrapolation.
limitations: Exact connected-path computation is limited to eleven vertices. The all-size result is for disjoint unions of the eleven-vertex path. No independent audit or universal publication-priority certificate is claimed.
title: First VC–Littlestone separation for minimal dominating sets of paths
